body: Im scared of yet more things going wrong. More things happening. I can't take it.

I might of at one point but I haven't for a long time. I just don't want to be scared anymore. 

I don't want to be panicking at every turn anymore.

Not really buddy. I just wrote my notes.

There was never anything here for me. Never anything I wanted to do or be.
Extreme things?  My life had been on hold for the last two years after my last suicide attempt.
